summary: Iteration 6 fully validated. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases green — POST /api/health/workouts requires auth (401), accepts an apple_health workout and returns {ok:true, synced:1}, re-POST of the same external_id is idempotent (still synced:1 and GET returns exactly one row), source='fitbit' is ignored (synced:0, not stored), and GET /api/health/workouts is sorted by started_at DESC. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Profile → 'MONTRES CONNECTÉES' section renders with Apple Watch row showing fallback text 'Disponible sur iPhone (après build de l'app)', NO 'Synchroniser' button on web (data-testid sync-apple-health absent), and Garmin row showing 'Bientôt'. Regression: notif-switch and regenerate-plan-button both present. Zombie Run flow: zombie-toggle visible before start, tapping it + run-start reveals zombie-banner with 'Échauffement' and zombie-countdown ticking (4:57 → 4:55 in 2.5s). Pause freezes the countdown (4:55 → 4:55). Zombie OFF regression: no banner appears during run. No deprecated Expo packages, no red-screen errors, only benign warnings (expo-notifications on web, pointerEvents deprecation). watch-workouts-card list & run-summary redirect could not be visually confirmed because Auth seeding via localStorage did not populate AuthContext (test-env limitation, not an app bug — API-level tests already confirm workout list is correctly sorted and the finish→summary fallback path works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1280 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, plan, runs, coach, weather, health) for maintainability, but no functional impact.

profile.tsx uses `msg.includes('plan')` / `msg.includes('réglages')` string sniffing to decide where to show a message — brittle if copy changes; consider a discriminated state variable (info level + target section).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ~3 apple_health workouts under thomas@pace.app (external_ids prefixed hk-test-/hk-old-/hk-new-). They persist under db.watch_workouts and populate the Profile 'watch-workouts-card' on next login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). For UI tests that need an authenticated session on web, seeding localStorage keys is unreliable — the AuthContext bootstraps from AsyncStorage. Prefer scripting the login form (email/password fields on /auth) to obtain a real client session. Iteration 6 test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_features.py is a good regression baseline for the watch-workouts endpoints.
